gates.detail: npm --prefix src/engine run build (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) then npm --prefix site run check — format:check, lint, typecheck, test (15 passed), test:browser (11 passed), test:build, and test:merge (synthetic merge proof) all passed

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.reason: npm --prefix site run merge needs a completed docs build in artifacts/docs from ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly. That step did not run in this environment (docs.ps1 missing, see 'Build documentation'), and the artifacts/docs directory on disk is stale build output from a prior session (last modified 2026-08-30, before today's verification pass), not a fresh build of this tree. Running merge against stale output would not verify anything about the current commit. Deferred to the PR's own 'Verify Documentation Build' check.

gates.name: Test the host
gates.reason: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests needs NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN (a read:packages token) to restore SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from GitHub Packages in the sibling SubZeroDev.Platform repository. That token is not present in this environment. Deferred to the PR's own host-image CI check.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: Requires building and running the host image, which itself requires restoring SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting via the same NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN / REGISTRY_TOKEN credential unavailable in this environment. Deferred to the PR's own host-image CI check.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: Depends on the base image built in the 'Positive route and probe smoke' step, which did not run for the same missing NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN / REGISTRY_TOKEN reason. Deferred to the PR's own host-image CI check.
